investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pinepoint Ride (ride-hailing); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.87.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pinepo-prod-apnort (EKS); safety-svc pods run with 4 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
